behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Conditional nested missing field and corresponding encoded summary target.
False or zero required value is present.
docDelivery: Strict conditional equality, required-before-minLength and missing-value definition.
Stable first-error-per-path summary with segment-wise URL encoding.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: values acyclic plain own-data JSON records with primitive leaf values; no getters/custom methods/undefined. Paths nonempty arrays of nonempty ASCII strings, own properties only. Each rule label string; required boolean optional; minLength nonnegative integer only on string-or-missing fields; when compares primitive strict equality.
independence: Integrate conditional required fields, nested validation paths and stable accessible error summaries.
